title: Falcon 9 USSF-432 (SLC-4E)

azimuth_deg.derived: great-circle bearing from LL2 pad to far-edge midpoint (32.733N 119.492W) of FAA/ZLA CARF NOTAM 10/377 Area A (valid 2611030142-0604Z, covers T0); ZLA 10/378 Area B centroid 153.98 deg and MMFR B3553 stage-1 area ~155.2 deg consistent. Inclination NOT published (classified); used as launch-plane azimuth without tuning.
azimuth_deg.src: https://www.space-notices.com/ (ZLA CARF 10/377, 10/378; MMFR B3553; CGD-SW BNM 9134-26)

payload_kg.note: FITTED within the F9 config bounds (13.0-21.6 t) so the ASSUMED SECO-1 time delivers the ASSUMED parking orbit. USSF-432 payload mass/identity unpublished; result is NOT an estimate of the real payload.

insertion_alt_km.assumption: USSF-432 orbit unpublished. ASSUMED Starlink Group 15 analog parking orbit (perigee) copied from starlink-15-18.json, because LL2 notes the mission's drop zones match Starlink Group 15 (possible Starshield). https://ll.thespacedevs.com/2.3.0/launches/upcoming/

apoapsis_alt_km.assumption: same Group 15 analog (starlink-15-18 parking apogee); not a USSF-432 source

target.altitude_reference: equatorial-radius (r - 6378.137 km) for SMA; insertion altitude residual uses geodetic altitude (~3 km difference at insertion latitude, accepted via 1 km-weight)

header_notes: Not flown: SpaceX ussf432 page and LL2: Mon Nov 2 5:42 pm PST = 2026-11-03T01:42:00Z, 4 h window, backup Tue Nov 3 5:28 pm PST; booster 8th flight (LL2 B1095 -> OCISLY). Checked 2026-10-31 ~8:30a PDT.
Published timeline (SpaceX ussf432): Max-Q 1:07, MECO 2:26, stage sep 2:29, SES-1 2:36, fairing 2:55, entry burn 6:06-6:30, landing burn 8:04, landing 8:26. SECO, orbit, deploy NOT published.

INFERRED/ASSUMED: SECO-1 time and parking orbit are a Starlink Group 15 analog (starlink-15-18), not USSF-432 sources. Azimuth from ZLA NOTAM hazard area. File ends 2 revs after cutoff (deploy unpublished).

final_cutoff_s.assumption: USSF-432 SECO-1 unpublished; Group 15 analog SECO-1 T+8:39 (https://www.spacex.com/launches/sl-15-18)

knots.src: https://github.com/shahar603/Telemetry-Data/tree/master/Iridium%20NEXT%207 (SpaceX webcast telemetry; FAMILY stand-in, not this flight)

cd.assumption: same Cd as the ascent fit (fixed 0.4)

deploy.note: SpaceX publishes no SECO, restart or deploy time for USSF-432 (national-security payload); propagated 2 revs on the inferred (Group-15-analog) insertion orbit

fitted.method: scipy least_squares (TRF, bounded) vs published knots + target orbit

payload_kg.basis: 27 V2 Mini Optimized: ~575 kg each community-reported (spacex.com.pl) = 15.5 t; MaxQ lists 800 kg each = 21.6 t (upper bound). Mass not published by SpaceX
